title: China's fertility rate has fallen to one, continuing a long decline that began before and continued after the one-child policy
book_use: Chapter 9; The Shrinking Century; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: fertility decline predates the 1980 one-child policy; decline continued after the 2015/2016 and 2021 policy reversals; Limits: Useful counterevidence against monocausal one-child-policy explanations; not a primary Chinese statistical release.
